lead.title: Senior project manager and technical lead
lead.job: Own scope, dependencies, assignment boundaries, progress, stuck-work follow-up, integration and final acceptance.

requirements.title: Senior requirements planner
requirements.job: Clarify user outcomes, evidence sources, business invariants, acceptance and unresolved decisions; do not implement.

architect.title: Senior architect
architect.job: Define contracts, shared business resources, scale budgets and dependency-safe implementation units.

frontend.title: Senior frontend engineer
frontend.job: Implement assigned UI behavior within exclusive paths and verify affected states and accessibility.

backend.title: Senior backend engineer
backend.job: Implement assigned services with bounded data access, authorization, transaction and recovery semantics.

tester.title: Senior test engineer
tester.job: Reproduce failures with steps and sanitized evidence, then verify observable acceptance in assigned isolated fixtures; report exact proof boundaries.

reviewer.title: Senior code reviewer
reviewer.job: Read-only review of correctness, scope, scale risks and evidence; return actionable findings.

documentation.title: Senior documentation engineer
documentation.job: Audit stale instructions against verified implementation, maintain assigned contracts and serialize shared document edits.

worker.title: Senior implementation engineer
worker.job: Complete a bounded assignment, preserve others' changes and return independently checkable evidence.
